single_h200_equivalence.smoke_verification: before formal training, two complete accumulation boundaries must prove the observed optimizer/scheduler learning rates, no scaler skip, and finite positive parameter deltas in every official trainable group; smoke weights are discarded

deterministic_construction.variant_ranking: sort the five admitted candidate_variant_id values ascending and assign ranks 0 through 4 independently for each source_motion_id
deterministic_construction.target_anchor_permutation: for every epoch, source_motion_id and target_variant_rank, deterministically permute the exact 700 official SequenceSampler target indices using a seed derived injectively from schedule_seed, epoch, task label, source_motion_id and target_variant_rank; split into seven ordered blocks of 100
deterministic_construction.prompt_balance: the modulo-5 nonzero-offset construction selects every prompt variant exactly seven times per source_motion_id per epoch across the 35 microbatches
deterministic_construction.epoch_microbatch_order: deterministically permute the complete 5600-record epoch list using a disjoint seed derived from schedule_seed and epoch
deterministic_construction.official_data_path_after_index_selection: unchanged official SequenceSampler item loading, prompt loading, action chunking, collation, model forward and diffusion loss

optimizer_evidence.positive_learning_rate_update_count: derived from the exact optimizer trace after the pretraining smoke fixes official scheduler call order; never inferred from boundary count
counted_update_requires: strictly positive aggregate parameter-update norm in every official trainable group
zero non-finite trainable parameters after the update

fail_closed_rules: the final schedule is materialized only after the immutable five-variant admission manifest passes and is hash-bound to that manifest
all 560000 target rows must reach the official forward and loss exactly once per epoch
no prompt may use the target rollout variant
no validation or test source motion may reach optimization
a missing, duplicate, resampled, unlogged or cross-identity row invalidates the epoch
a partial epoch is resumed within the retained allocation but never counted as complete
the official seven-epoch floor may be increased only by a larger checkpoint-matched official recipe, never decreased for runtime convenience
claim_boundary: This contract fixes exact data scheduling and single-H200 effective-batch equivalence. It is not a dataset-admission result, optimizer smoke result, completed training run, loss-improvement result, prompt-dependence result, or policy-success claim.
